# Historical Revolution source used for Android porting reference

This directory is the Go module snapshot:

`github.com/nosyliam/revolution@v0.0.0-20250120031029-3f890744b55a`

downloaded from the public Go module proxy. It was published January 20, 2025 and carries its upstream licensing files.

It is **historical reference source**. It is not asserted to be the source of the current RevolutionMacro.exe release used by this Android project. Android-specific work must preserve this distinction and the upstream licensing notices.
